name: Evendo
description: Evendo is an icebound twin world of Kavaron near the supervoid Sothera, being terraformed by Eumidians and coveted by the Kavaronic Empire.

timeline.summary: Eumidians of the Evendo strain land on the planet Evendo and begin terraforming it.
timeline.quote: The Evendo-strain Eumidians are the specific strain of Eumidians that have landed on the planet Evendo , in the Sothera system .

citation.work: Insect
citation.text: "Insect", section "Evendo-strain Eumidians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kadrik recounts gnawing off his left hind leg shortly after hatching and getting a fungal replacement foot.
timeline.quote: I got a little too excited and ended up gnawing off the end of my left hind leg

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik explains his mission to retrieve the last unhatched pods and that failing it means being reprocessed.
timeline.quote: My ongoing mission is to retrieve the last few unhatched pods scattered across the muddy plains.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Gobbler repeatedly eats the pods Kadrik finds.
timeline.quote: She chases me away and—you won't believe this—gobbles up my find.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik cuts off comms and deserts toward the tundra.
timeline.quote: I'm cutting off comms, spitting out my tracker, and deserting.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: On the fifth day Kadrik finds a Kav stasis pod camouflaged on the tundra.
timeline.quote: I nearly miss the stasis pod

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik sees that the pod holds a living human.
timeline.quote: Inside is not a Kav. It's a human.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik decides to bring the human back to the enclave.
timeline.quote: I hitch the stasis pod to my sledge and turn back toward the enclave.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Gobbler throws Kadrik's sledge and attacks the pod.
timeline.quote: I'm knocked out of my sledge as it flies backward and crashes on its side in an explosion of dirt.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik flees and leaves the human to Gobbler.
timeline.quote: I scramble over, shove my sledge upright, and scramble on.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Guilt-ridden, Kadrik turns back to rescue the human.
timeline.quote: With a snarl, I swing the sledge back around.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik jams his staff and energy pack into Gobbler's jaws and the blast stuns her.
timeline.quote: I rip off my energy pack.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys Kadrik's foot, which regrows from mycelial tissue.
timeline.quote: The whole world flashes green as pain engulfs my left hind leg.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik reaches the enclave, where Zoritt hits him and tells him the recycling threat was a joke.
timeline.quote: What I don't expect, when we finally reach the enclave, is for Zoritt to knock me over the head with xir fist.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Zoritt says it was a joke that they would recycle him.
timeline.quote: That was a joke, you idiot!

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Zoritt and the scientists move the human into a biocradle, and Kadrik takes the cylinder clutched in the human's hand.
timeline.quote: There's a cylindrical thing clenched in one hand, and I swipe it before Zoritt banishes me and Pabkoh outside.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik eats the cylinder, thinking it a snack.
timeline.quote: I pop it in my mouth and crunch down.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik meets the awakened human, who introduces himself as Noz.
timeline.quote: I-I'm Noz

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kadrik exaggerates that he fought off five megafauna with bare hands.
timeline.quote: Had to fight off five megafauna with bare hands.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz says he is from Pinnacle's programming division and was captured by the Kav.
timeline.quote: We were on a team-building exercise when the Kav took us captive.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz tells them he was in stasis for three years.
timeline.quote: Three years, I know.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz warns that the Kav are biding their time with a new warship.
timeline.quote: We were taken by a brand-new warship and held on a station retrofitted for battle.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz insists on leaving to reach his family and report to Pinnacle.
timeline.quote: But I have a daughter.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz asks for his pencil and learns Kadrik ate it.
timeline.quote: Oh, your snack. I ate it. Sorry.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz encourages Kadrik to be the first Eumidian artist.
timeline.quote: Maybe you can be the first to change that.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz thanks Kadrik and invites him to visit Guideline before leaving.
timeline.quote: Maybe you can even visit me on Guideline.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: After Noz leaves, Kadrik begins to draw a pair of tusks in the dirt with the stick.
timeline.quote: Then I crouch down, digging one end of the stick into the soft dirt, and begin to draw a pair of tusks.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kav colonists turn to Evendo for mining after wrecking Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Kav colonizers, having all but destroyed their homeworld of Kavaron, have turned their attention toward Evendo as a place to mine for natural resources.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Szarel commits to the Evendo terrasymbiosis knowing he will not see it finished.
timeline.quote: Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion, but he has committed his life to advancing the cause.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Falling shards of Kavaron shattered Evendo's icy shell, awakening dormant life.
timeline.quote: When falling shards of Kavaron shattered the icy shell of Evendo, the Eumidian seed pods were far from the only form of life awakened from slumber.

citation.work: Fungal Colossus
citation.text: Fungal Colossus (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Eumidians became the natural predator of a swarm.
timeline.quote: The swarm lacked a natural predator, so the Eumidians became one.

citation.work: Swarm Culler
citation.text: Swarm Culler (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eumidians on Evendo leave hibernation because meteors from crumbling Kavaron heat the planet.
timeline.quote: Left hibernation recently due to the heating of Evendo from meteors originating from the crumbling planet Kavaron.

citation.work: Edge
citation.text: "Edge", section "Factions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hearthhull found the Sothera system and planted a brood on Evendo.
timeline.quote: Hearthhull , a Eumidian seedship, found the Sothera system by chance and planted a brood on Evendo.

citation.work: Evendo
citation.text: "Evendo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kavaron's deformation rained debris on Evendo, warming it and waking the Eumidians.
timeline.quote: This warming triggered the first wave of Eumidians to awaken from hibernation

citation.work: Evendo
